python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv,io
pay='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
D=Decimal; q=D('.01'); wh=D('.2137'); mul=D('1.73')
t1=t2=D(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(pay)):
    gross=D(r['regular_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])+D(r['overtime_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])*mul
    net=(gross*(1-wh)-D(r['deduction']))
    rn=net.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    rg=gross.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    rn2=(rg*(1-wh)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'],gross, rg, net, rn, rn2)
    t1+=rn;t2+=rn2
print('tot direct',t1,'round gross first',t2)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
d=Decimal
DR=d('0.0837'); TR=d('0.0673'); CENT=d('0.01')
total=d('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)):
    raw=d(r['quantity'])*d(r['unit_price'])*(d('1')-DR)*(d('1')+TR)+d(r['shipping'])
    amt=raw.quantize(CENT,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    total+=amt
    print(r['record_id'], raw, amt)
print('COUNT',10,'TOTAL',total)
PY

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, getcontext
from io import StringIO
import csv
s='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,freight
SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454
SUP-005,363,124.67,189
SUP-006,233,17.23,154
SUP-007,64,57.17,700
SUP-008,373,134.81,599
SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518
'''
e=Decimal('1.1379'); d=Decimal('0.0427'); cent=Decimal('0.01')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(StringIO(s)))
total=Decimal(0)
for r in rows:
    x=(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])+Decimal(r['freight']))*e*(Decimal(1)+d)
    q=x.quantize(cent, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
